items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I just sat in with Chick when he was out here and went over to his house at a Valentine’s Day party or something, and played a little bit.

ctx.x: How about Chick Corea? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
Chick Corea, I just sat in with Chick when he was out here and went over to his house at a Valentine’s Day party or something, and played a little bit.
He’s always liked jazz flute, hasn’t he?
